The '''KX5''', manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]], was a fighter-scale [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The KX5 was used in, among other craft, [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]/[[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighters]], [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], and [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]].
